about: Engine E4's precomputed library for SB4, M13 and C4 (learn/sb4-pathway-explorer.qmd, m13-national-pathway.qmd, c4-prairieland-2050.qmd): every preset with perfect foresight and decade by decade, and the central plan without the peak-hour rule, solved with E4 itself on 7 November 2026 (each LP optimal, at most 120 s a solve), its view (every number a page shows), C4's four shocks re-planned, and the full-year checks of 2030 and 2050 in 2025's and 2024's weather (52 weeks and 31 December, an LP each). Phones read it instead of loading the solver; the full-year checks are too slow for a click. Written by node _tests/learn/test_e4-engine.js --write; checked byte for byte (--library: every entry).
